title: GLASS ADJUSTMENT PROCEDURE
summary: Coupe (19437) section views for the K12 glass adjustment procedure: how the side door glass should sit against the windshield-side weatherstrip (A-A), front roof panel (B-B), roof panel side weatherstrip (C-C), rear weatherstrip at the lock pillar (D-D, E-E), and the two gage blocks used to locate the glass rear edge (View A). Dimensions are nominal design values.
notes: Section A-A (glass front edge to w/shield side w/strip): .04 PARALLEL
Section C-C (roof panel side w/strip to glass upper edge): .30 PARALLEL; .06 PARALLEL
Section E-E: labels SIDE DOOR GLASS, DOOR W/STRIP, REAR EDGE OF GLASS W/STRIP
View A (gage blocks at rear edge of glass): .44; .60; 8.00; .50
NOTE The dimensions given in these sections are nominal design dimensions.
notes_internal: Drawing-only page for K12 (p151): no callouts, no parts, no torque legend, so no fastening entries.
Section cut lines A-A to E-E and View A arrow are marked on the door-glass/roof perspective at upper right.

View A: two hatched gage blocks between glass and rear roof seal rabbit; 8.00 spacing between blocks, .50 from the lower block to a reference edge; .44 and .60 are widths at top and middle (exact references not labelled).
Which dimension in Section C-C is .30 vs .06: .30 PARALLEL is the glass-to-flange offset at top, .06 PARALLEL the gap to the w/strip lip (matches step 13 '.06 minimum swing clearance').
